title: LootChance
description: A highly configurable mob loot plugin with support for custom drops, Looting scaling, multiple item providers
body:
LootChance is a lightweight and highly configurable Paper plugin that gives server owners full control over mob loot tables without replacing the entire vanilla loot system.

Create custom drops for any mob, adjust drop chances, configure minimum and maximum amounts, and fine-tune Looting enchantment bonuses. Choose whether to keep vanilla drops or completely replace them on a per-mob basis.

The plugin also supports multiple item providers, allowing you to use both vanilla Minecraft items and custom items from supported plugins such as MMOItems.

## Features

- Fully configurable mob loot tables
- Support for every vanilla mob
- ADD and REPLACE drop modes
- Configurable drop chances
- Configurable minimum and maximum drop amounts
- Looting enchantment support
- Multiple item providers (Vanilla, MMOItems, and more)
- Lightweight and optimized
- Easy-to-read YAML configuration
- Built for modern Paper versions

Perfect for survival, RPG, economy, and custom gameplay servers.
